name: Old Fashioned
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Sugar cube
ingredients.notes: Dissolve fully before adding ice.

ingredients.name: Angostura bitters
ingredients.notes: Seed fixes the IBA “few dashes” at three; calibrate the dasher.

prepInstructions: Dissolve the sugar with bitters and water in the glass.
Add whiskey and ice, then stir until cold with balanced dilution.
Express the orange zest and garnish.
serviceNotes: Three dashes are a measured seed convention. For a syrup version, validate sweetness and dilution before replacing the sugar cube.
variations: Rye gives a drier, spicier style; bourbon a rounder one.

name: Negroni
subtitle: Classic reference
prepInstructions: Add all three measured ingredients to an ice-filled rocks glass.
Stir to chill and dilute, then garnish.
serviceNotes: Equal parts is the reference; a venue override may choose another ratio. Refrigerate opened vermouth.

name: Margarita
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Lime juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh juice; keep chilled and follow the venue date-label policy.

prepInstructions: If requested, salt half the rim before building the drink.
Shake the measured liquids with ice.
Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
serviceNotes: IBA proportions are the selected reference. Lime acidity and liqueur sweetness vary; follow the approved venue balance.
variations: Tommy’s Margarita replaces orange liqueur with agave nectar.

name: Tommy's Margarita
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Lime juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh juice; keep chilled and follow the venue date-label policy.

ingredients.name: Agave nectar
ingredients.notes: IBA reference amount; agave nectar concentration varies by brand.

prepInstructions: Shake the tequila, lime and agave nectar with ice.
Strain over fresh cubed ice and garnish.
serviceNotes: Agave concentration materially changes sweetness. This seed follows the IBA amount; many bars use less nectar, so confirm the venue standard.

name: Daiquiri
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Lime juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh juice; keep chilled and follow the venue date-label policy.

ingredients.name: Superfine sugar
ingredients.notes: Dry sugar; barspoon volume is not treated as a liquid measurement.

prepInstructions: Stir rum, lime and sugar in a shaker until the sugar dissolves.
Add ice and shake until chilled.
Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
serviceNotes: This reference uses the IBA dry-sugar formulation. Do not swap sugar for the same volume of syrup without validating the spec.
variations: Adjust the approved recipe for the juice and sweetener used.

name: Mojito
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Lime juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh juice; keep chilled and follow the venue date-label policy.

ingredients.name: Mint leaves
ingredients.notes: Use tender leaves; muddle gently, without shredding.

ingredients.name: White cane sugar
ingredients.notes: Seed treats one level barspoon as the stated teaspoon for dry sugar.

ingredients.name: Soda water
ingredients.notes: Add chilled at service; never shake carbonation.

prepInstructions: Gently press mint with sugar and lime in the glass.
Add a little soda to dissolve the sugar.
Fill with ice, add rum and top with chilled soda.
Lift gently with a spoon, then garnish.
serviceNotes: Mint leaf count is a practical seed adaptation of the IBA mint instruction. Add mint and soda at service; do not hold muddled mint in a bulk batch.

name: Cosmopolitan
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Lime juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh juice; keep chilled and follow the venue date-label policy.

prepInstructions: Shake all liquids with ice until very cold.
Fine strain into a chilled coupe and express the twist.
serviceNotes: Use the approved cranberry product consistently; juice drinks vary in sugar.

name: Espresso Martini
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Sugar syrup
ingredients.notes: 1:1 sugar to water by weight unless the product label specifies otherwise.

ingredients.name: Fresh espresso
ingredients.notes: One espresso is represented as 30 ml; calibrate extraction to the venue coffee recipe.

prepInstructions: Prepare a fresh espresso and measure it.
Shake all liquids firmly with ice to create a fine crema.
Fine strain into a chilled coupe and place three beans on top.
serviceNotes: Espresso is made at service. Taste with the chosen coffee liqueur; sweetness and caffeine depend on the products used.

name: Pornstar Martini
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Champagne
ingredients.notes: Serve separately in a small chilled glass.

prepInstructions: Dissolve the vanilla sugar into the non-sparkling ingredients.
Shake those ingredients with ice and fine strain into a chilled coupe.
Garnish and serve Champagne alongside.
serviceNotes: IBA-style reference uses purée and vanilla sugar. Lime/syrup/Prosecco versions are common variations, not silently interchangeable.

name: Whiskey Sour
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Lemon juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh juice; keep chilled and follow the venue date-label policy.

ingredients.name: Sugar syrup
ingredients.notes: 1:1 sugar to water by weight unless the product label specifies otherwise.

ingredients.name: Pasteurised egg white (optional)
ingredients.notes: Optional seed measure for foam; IBA describes only a few drops. Confirm allergies and the venue egg procedure.

prepInstructions: If using egg white, combine ingredients and shake without ice.
Add ice and shake until well chilled.
Fine strain over fresh ice and garnish.
serviceNotes: Egg is optional and this version includes it in the displayed spec. For an egg-free order, omit it and use clean equipment under the venue allergen procedure.
variations: The egg-free version is also a standard Whiskey Sour.

name: Amaretto Sour
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Lemon juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh juice; keep chilled and follow the venue date-label policy.

ingredients.name: Rich sugar syrup
ingredients.notes: 2:1 sugar to water by weight.

prepInstructions: Combine the liquids and shake without ice to emulsify.
Shake again with ice.
Fine strain over fresh ice and garnish.
serviceNotes: Morgenthaler-style modern variation with bourbon. Amaretto formulations vary: verify nut/allergen statements on the actual bottle.
variations: A liqueur-only sour is another established version.

name: Mai Tai
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Orgeat syrup
ingredients.notes: Contains almond in this reference; verify supplier allergen information.

ingredients.name: Lime juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh juice; keep chilled and follow the venue date-label policy.

ingredients.name: Sugar syrup
ingredients.notes: 1:1 sugar to water by weight unless the product label specifies otherwise.

garnish: Mint, pineapple spear and lime peel
prepInstructions: Shake the liquids with ice.
Pour into a double rocks glass and add fresh crushed ice as needed.
Set the mint, pineapple and lime garnish.
serviceNotes: The IBA reference specifies a molasses-based Martinique rum, not automatically rhum agricole. Rum blend and orgeat vary between bars.

name: Martini
subtitle: Classic reference
prepInstructions: Stir gin and vermouth with ice until cold and diluted.
Strain into a chilled Martini glass.
Express citrus oils over the surface.
serviceNotes: A 2:1 gin-to-vermouth reference inspired by the Plymouth Douglas Martini. Ask for the guest’s spirit, dryness and garnish preference.
variations: Dry Martini uses a 6:1 ratio in this library.
Vodka may replace gin by guest request.

name: Dry Martini
subtitle: Classic reference
prepInstructions: Stir gin and vermouth with plenty of ice until cold.
Strain into a deeply chilled Martini glass.
Express lemon oils or add the requested olive.
serviceNotes: The selected IBA reference is 6:1. Extra dry, wet and vodka variations should use the venue’s approved recipe.

name: Dirty Martini
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Olive brine
ingredients.notes: Strain the brine and keep refrigerated under the supplier instructions.

prepInstructions: Measure vodka, vermouth and strained olive brine.
Stir with ice until chilled and diluted.
Strain into a chilled glass and add an olive pick.
serviceNotes: A 5:1:1 vodka/vermouth/brine reference, scaled from the producer recipe. Brine salinity varies; confirm the guest’s preferred dirtiness.

name: French Martini
subtitle: Classic reference
prepInstructions: Shake all liquids with ice until a fine pineapple foam forms.
Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
Express lemon oils over the surface.
serviceNotes: The IBA reference uses 15 ml pineapple. Many modern bars use more; publish a venue override if the approved recipe differs.

name: Manhattan
subtitle: Classic reference
prepInstructions: Stir all liquids with ice to chill and dilute.
Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a cherry.
serviceNotes: Refrigerate opened vermouth. Bourbon is a common guest preference and creates a rounder variation.

name: Boulevardier
subtitle: Classic reference
prepInstructions: Stir the measured liquids with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe and express the orange zest.
serviceNotes: The selected reference is 45:30:30. Rocks service is a common alternative.

name: Paloma
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Lime juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh juice; keep chilled and follow the venue date-label policy.

ingredients.name: Fine salt
ingredients.notes: One small pinch per serve; top is used as an unmeasured seasoning unit.

ingredients.name: Pink grapefruit soda
ingredients.notes: Add chilled at service; never shake carbonation.

prepInstructions: Add tequila, lime and a small pinch of salt to an ice-filled highball.
Add chilled grapefruit soda.
Stir gently and garnish.
serviceNotes: Use a carbonated grapefruit soda for this reference. Fresh grapefruit juice versions need a separate sweetness and carbonation spec.

name: Sidecar
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Lemon juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh juice; keep chilled and follow the venue date-label policy.

prepInstructions: If requested, prepare a sugar half rim.
Shake all measured liquids with ice.
Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
serviceNotes: No garnish is required by the IBA reference; a sugar rim is a venue/guest variation.

name: Aviation
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Lemon juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh juice; keep chilled and follow the venue date-label policy.

ingredients.name: Crème de violette
ingredients.notes: Calibrate barspoon capacity locally; this unit is not converted into litres.

prepInstructions: Shake all measured ingredients with ice.
Fine strain into a chilled coupe.
Add a cherry if desired.
serviceNotes: Violet liqueur strength and sweetness vary. The selected IBA reference includes it; omission is a historical variation.

name: Bramble
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Lemon juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh juice; keep chilled and follow the venue date-label policy.

ingredients.name: Sugar syrup
ingredients.notes: 1:1 sugar to water by weight unless the product label specifies otherwise.

ingredients.name: Crème de mûre
ingredients.notes: Drizzle over the finished drink, not into the batch.

prepInstructions: Shake gin, lemon and syrup with ice.
Strain over fresh crushed ice.
Drizzle the blackberry liqueur over the top and garnish.
serviceNotes: Keep crème de mûre separate so the service finish remains visible.

name: Tom Collins
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Lemon juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh juice; keep chilled and follow the venue date-label policy.

ingredients.name: Sugar syrup
ingredients.notes: 1:1 sugar to water by weight unless the product label specifies otherwise.

ingredients.name: Soda water
ingredients.notes: Add chilled at service; never shake carbonation.

prepInstructions: Build gin, lemon and syrup in an ice-filled highball.
Add chilled soda and stir gently.
Garnish with lemon and a cherry.
serviceNotes: IBA’s John Collins reference specifies Old Tom gin for a Tom Collins. A London dry version is widely used but should be labelled in venue content.

name: French 75
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Lemon juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh juice; keep chilled and follow the venue date-label policy.

ingredients.name: Sugar syrup
ingredients.notes: 1:1 sugar to water by weight unless the product label specifies otherwise.

prepInstructions: Shake gin, lemon and syrup with ice.
Fine strain into a chilled flute.
Add chilled Champagne and gently combine.
serviceNotes: Keep sparkling wine out of the shaker and batch. Prepare the shaken portion at service for correct dilution.

name: Caipirinha
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: White cane sugar
ingredients.notes: Seed uses level barspoons for the IBA teaspoons; calibrate the actual spoon.

prepInstructions: Gently muddle the lime wedges and sugar in the glass.
Add cracked ice and cachaça.
Stir until chilled and combined.
serviceNotes: Build individually to preserve the fresh lime aroma. Do not blend cachaça with generic rum in inventory or recipe data.
variations: Caipiroska uses vodka in place of cachaça.

name: Piña Colada
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Coconut cream
ingredients.notes: Check whether the approved product is sweetened; recipes must be balanced for that product.

ingredients.name: Ice
ingredients.notes: Illustrative blender load; tune to the blender and ice type.

prepInstructions: Measure rum, coconut cream and pineapple juice into the blender.
Add the approved ice load and blend until smooth.
Pour into a chilled hurricane glass and garnish.
serviceNotes: The IBA liquid ratio is used. Ice weight is a seed starting point and is never counted in liquid batch volume. Coconut cream is not dairy cream; check actual product allergens.

name: Dark 'n' Stormy
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Ginger beer
ingredients.notes: Add chilled at service; never shake carbonation.

prepInstructions: Add chilled ginger beer to an ice-filled highball.
Float the rum over the ginger beer.
Garnish with lime.
serviceNotes: The IBA reference specifies Goslings rum. Add carbonated ginger beer only at service.

name: Moscow Mule
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Ginger beer
ingredients.notes: Add chilled at service; never shake carbonation.

ingredients.name: Lime juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh juice; keep chilled and follow the venue date-label policy.

prepInstructions: Fill a food-safe lined mule mug or highball with ice.
Add vodka, lime and chilled ginger beer.
Stir gently and garnish.
serviceNotes: Use a suitable food-contact vessel. Keep ginger beer sealed and chilled until service.

name: Bloody Mary
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Lemon juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh juice; keep chilled and follow the venue date-label policy.

ingredients.name: Hot sauce
ingredients.notes: Seed starting point; adjust to guest preference.

ingredients.name: Celery salt and black pepper
ingredients.notes: Season to taste.

prepInstructions: Combine vodka, tomato, lemon and Worcestershire sauce with ice.
Roll gently between tins or stir; avoid aerating heavily.
Season to the guest’s taste and serve over fresh ice.
serviceNotes: Standard Worcestershire sauce can contain fish and barley. Confirm exact bottle allergens; do not claim this reference is vegetarian or gluten-free.

name: Long Island Iced Tea
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Lemon juice
ingredients.notes: Use fresh juice; keep chilled and follow the venue date-label policy.

ingredients.name: Sugar syrup
ingredients.notes: 1:1 sugar to water by weight unless the product label specifies otherwise.

ingredients.name: Cola
ingredients.notes: Add chilled at service; never shake carbonation.

prepInstructions: Measure the spirits, lemon and syrup into an ice-filled highball.
Top with chilled cola.
Stir gently and garnish.
serviceNotes: This IBA-style recipe contains five measured spirits/liqueurs. Keep portions exact; cola is added only at service.

name: Aperol Spritz
subtitle: Classic reference

ingredients.name: Soda water
ingredients.notes: Add chilled at service; never shake carbonation.

prepInstructions: Fill a wine glass with plenty of cubed ice.
Add chilled Prosecco, Aperol and soda.
Lift gently with a spoon and garnish.
serviceNotes: The 90:60:30 seed makes the IBA soda splash explicit using the common 3:2:1 convention.
